task: register the packaged macOS application with LaunchServices after PKG installation

conformance.reason: This fixes an existing macOS installer integration gap within the current Desktop release contract; it does not change application architecture, API, storage, or lifecycle ownership.

rows.requirement: A macOS PKG install registers /Applications/ElfieNest.app for the active console user so Launchpad can discover it, while preserving the packaged global elfienest launcher.
runtime_scenarios: Install the rebuilt darwin-x64 PKG, inspect LaunchServices registration, and verify the app is discoverable from Launchpad.
platform_conditions: A logged-in console user and the native PKG installer are available
evidence: command: UV_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/elfienest-uv-cache ./.venv/bin/python scripts/release.py --target darwin-x64 (PKG built; coordinator only reported release-install-smoke-unavailable)
review: extracted PKG Scripts archive contains postinstall with LaunchServices stale-entry cleanup, active console-user lookup, launchctl asuser, and -f /Applications/ElfieNest.app
host: macOS 14.8.7 user LaunchServices dump contains /Applications/ElfieNest.app with identifier com.elfienest.desktop, APPL type, relative icon, and x86_64 slice after stale-entry cleanup
residuals: The repaired PKG postinstall has not executed on this machine; install it with administrator authorization, then confirm the app appears in Launchpad.
blockers: sudo installer requires the macOS administrator password; the agent cannot supply or store that password
